Package lab6javadoc

Class SortExample

  • java.lang.Object
    • lab6javadoc.SortExample
  • public class SortExample
extends java.lang.Object
    Provides sorting utility methods including Quick Sort and Merge Sort, along with helper methods for swapping elements and verifying sort order.

      • quickSort

        public static void quickSort​(java.lang.Integer[] arr,
                             int low,

        Sorts an array of Integers in ascending order using the Quick Sort algorithm.

        low - The starting index of the subarray to sort.

      • mergeSort

        public static void mergeSort​(int[] a,

        Recursively divides and sorts an integer array using the Merge Sort algorithm.

      • merge

        public static void merge​(int[] a,
                         int[] l,
                         int[] r,
                         int left,
                         int right)
        Merges two sorted subarrays into a single sorted array.
        Parameters:
        a - The destination array to store merged elements.
        l - The left sorted subarray.
        r - The right sorted subarray.
        left - The number of elements in the left subarray.
        right - The number of elements in the right subarray.
